note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording and the OT renderings made in its register: Torrey's cited verses, the verses he recites inside his own sentences, and the phrases he quotes again to argue from.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, the shortest span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Where OWB opens an inner quotation inside a verse, the inner marks are ‹ ›. Torrey's italics stay on the matching OWB words. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, Torrey's second-person paraphrases of what Scripture tells the believer, and the reader's own answers and prayers he scripts.

Judgement calls. Acts 13:39 'justified from all things' is OWB «… ካልቻለበት ነገር ሁሉ የሚያምን ሁሉ በእርሱ ነጻ ይወጣል» ('set free'); it is quoted as OWB has it, Torrey's gloss (ማለትም በክርስቶስ) stands outside the marks, and his prose about being justified stays his. John 1:12 'power/right to become' is OWB «መብት». Hebrews 7:25 'to the uttermost' is OWB «ሙሉ በሙሉ», echoed identically. 1 Thessalonians 5:17 is OWB «መጸለይን አታቋርጡ» (decision pray-without-ceasing). John 15:16 follows OWB's order, with Torrey's two italic phrases kept on the matching words.
